lines.zh: 我贴着地面蠕动着前进。
lines.en: I crawl forward, low to the ground.

lines.zh: 我的节肢一下一下推着身体。
lines.en: My segments push my body along.
This shell slows me down.
I crawl along the swarm's route.
I go around a puddle.
My feelers test the way ahead.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有气味的方向去。
lines.en: I move slowly toward a scent.
I push the dust aside.
I pause, then crawl on.

lines.zh: 我从倒下的木头下钻过。
lines.en: I slip under a fallen log.
I travel along the base of the wall.
I crawl toward darker ground.

lines.zh: 我调整了方向，虫潮的低吼还在后面。
lines.en: I adjusted course; the swarm's growl lingers behind.
My body contracts and extends.
I climb a slight slope.
The soil's too loose; I shrink back to where I was.
I lie in the dark, breathing slowly.
My shell rises and falls in segments.
A low growl comes from beneath my shell.
I listen to the swarm's echoes.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，我用触须看你。
lines.en: Eyeless, I look at you with my feelers.
I have no eyes, yet I sense.

lines.zh: 我伏在土里，等震动靠近。
lines.en: I lie in the soil, waiting for the tremor to near.
The air is thick with my kin.
I flatten my body further.
Vibrations reach me through the ground.
I wait for the next meal.
My legs tap lightly on the ground.
You're standing on the swarm's path.
I turn my skull your way.

lines.zh: 你没有壳，热气全露在外。
lines.en: You have no shell; all your heat is exposed.
My kin are already closing in.
I don't roar; I only come closer.
Your leg is longer than all of me.
I prop up my front segments.
One step back is enough. No more.
I'm not short of kin here.
You've stepped on my path.
I draw every leg under my shell.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，里面还在动。
lines.en: A crack in my shell — something still moves inside.
I hiss and recoil.
Fluid seeps from my shell's seam.
I unfold my body again.
This chip will mend.
The swarm growls and closes around me.
I remember your heat.
I can still crawl forward.
I retreat into shadow.

lines.zh: 这气味带着体温，是活的。
lines.en: This scent carries warmth. It's alive.
I edge toward it slowly.
I test a small bite with my mouthparts.
This is tenderer than bug flesh.
My kin crowd toward it.
On the ground, then I'll crawl over.
I taste it; it'll do.
Too little for the swarm.
I drag it to the corner.

lines.zh: 这味道是活的，我又抬头看你。
lines.en: This smell is alive; I look up at you again.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我立刻缩起来。
lines.en: You stepped on me and I curled at once.
My shell is hard; don't tread.

lines.zh: 你的鞋压塌了我旁边的土。
lines.en: Your boot caves in the soil beside me.
I hit the log and bounced back.
You scraped against my shell.
I squeeze into the crack at the wall's base.
We stir up the dust.
My kin have come close.
One bump and my shell doesn't sway.
Shell scraping dirt, I keep crawling.

lines.zh: 另一只节肢的声音靠近。
lines.en: Another segmented sound comes near.
Our feelers touch.
Its shell is glossier than mine.
We bury the eggs in the soil.

lines.zh: 这条虫潮路线够养活它们。
lines.en: This swarm route can feed them.
We lie together in the dark.
Our legs tap against each other.
Vibrations link us.
In this moment the soil is still.
We scatter apart again.
I bite it with my mouthparts.
I drag it into the wall crack.
This has little taste.

lines.zh: 咬下去咔一声，壳差点崩。
lines.en: It cracks as I bite; my jaw nearly gives.

lines.zh: 我用腹甲把它压进土里。
lines.en: I press it into the soil under my belly plate.
My kin came and fought for it.

lines.zh: 我用口器把它顶到墙缝。
lines.en: I shove it into the wall crack with my mouthparts.
I swallow this down.
It's caught in my segment joint.

lines.zh: 我这一身甲壳素，咔咔响。
lines.en: This chitin shell of mine clicks.
Something's moving on that path.
I press my feelers that way.
My kin all head that way.
I press in that direction.
It's just ahead, not far.
I open my jaws, ready to bite.
My legs begin to move.
It alone is on this path.
I have chosen it.
It's at the wall, and there's no crack that way.

lines.zh: 我从它脚底的土里穿过去。
lines.en: I pass under the soil beneath its feet.
My legs grip the soil. I'm moving.
I squeeze forward segment by segment.

lines.zh: 它每步都震着我的触须。
lines.en: Every step it takes shakes my feelers.
I press flatter.
This stretch keeps shortening.
My kin gather in along the damp soil.

lines.zh: 虫潮的甲壳，在我背上响。
lines.en: Swarm chitin rattles on my back.
I reroute through the soil crack.
It has stopped; good.
I squeeze a length nearer.

lines.zh: 我支起前几节，张开口器。
lines.en: I rear up my front segments and open my mouthparts.
Good, just so.
I'm about to move.
My mouthparts clamp its shin.
I slam my front half in.
I snarl and tear.
My kin lunge from the other side.
It's dragged down.
My mouthparts are serrated.
I release and reposition.
I follow by tearing a piece.
This strength will do.
I retreat into the dark.
I crawl out of a ground fissure.
A clatter comes from under the floor.
The Crawling Blight shows itself.
I extend my segments one by one.
The smell of the swarm arrives.
I come out from under the wood.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面蠕动，同伴跟在后面。
lines.en: I crawl belly-low, my kin following.
First I raise my feelers.
This ground is ours to crawl.
I pause and listen.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，节缝都在响。
lines.en: Fire roasts my shell and the joints creak.

lines.zh: 我从高处滚下，摔成一团。
lines.en: I roll off a height and land in a heap.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的节缝，动不了。
lines.en: Water fills my joints and I can't move.
The blast flips my shell over.
An arrow pierces my carapace.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的节肢发僵。
lines.en: The light stiffens my limbs.
Too hungry to crawl fast.

lines.zh: 雷打在地上，我全身缩紧。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the ground and I clench up.
There's no ground here to crawl on.
